{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Wood}}
[[File:Greel_Tree.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[logger]] uses a [[vibrosaw]] to harvest [[Greel wood/Legends|greel wood]] from a [[greel tree]].]]
'''Wood''' was a generic term for building materials which could be obtained from [[Tree/Legends|trees]]. Important woods included [[Greel wood/Legends|greel wood]], harvested from the [[greel tree]]s of [[Pii III]] and [[Pii IV]];<ref name="TGWH">{{JournalCite|6|The Greel Wood Haven}}</ref> [[Wroshyr wood/Legends|wroshyr-wood]], obtained from the giant [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr trees]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]];<ref name="TJK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref> and [[Alderaanian rainbow wood]], a commodity made scarce following the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="HSSB">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Wood had a number of uses. The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] used lightweight [[sacred wood]] in the construction of [[Hang-glider/Legends|skin gliders]].<ref name="Ewoks 3">[[Ewoks (1985) 3|''Ewoks'' (1985) 3]]</ref> It was sometimes used to signify luxury, including as interior paneling on luxury [[Landspeeder/Legends|speeders]] like the [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian]] [[LuxurPort Zisparanza]], which was paneled with Alderaanian rainbow wood until its scarcity forced the manufacturers to switch to scarlet-hued greel wood.<ref name="HSSB" />

Those who harvested wood from trees professionally were known as [[logger]]s.<ref name="TGWH" /> A group of [[Rok's species|alien loggers]] came to Endor to harvest wood from the forest moon's many [[Soul Tree]]s, sacred to the native Ewoks; but their operation was thwarted by the young Ewoks [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket]] and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesa]], and the young [[Foonar]] [[Dooni]].<ref name="Ewoks 5">[[Ewoks (1985) 5|''Ewoks'' (1985) 5]]</ref>
